_comment: Published, versioned weight tables for the momentum index. compute_index.py reads THIS file; changing a weight here changes the chart on next run, in lockstep with the verifier. category_weightings score by a row's category; event_weightings score by its event_type (a different operationalization of 'what counts as an achievement').

labels.W1: frontier-forward (innovation + science x1.5; structurally favors the US)
labels.W2: build-and-develop (infrastructure + industrial + social + governmental_economic x1.5; structurally favors China)
labels.W3: event-type frontier (discovery + invention + founding x1.5; a US-leaning cross-check on a different axis)
